_README: US version (Michigan sample). province = the state code (e.g. MI). locale = html language (en-US). temps = the cold/hot numbers in the hero and no-heat band and the thermostat intro (unit F or C, from = starting reading, set = set point). Edit these values for each client, then run: python3 _build/build.py && python3 _build/qa.py. Values marked SAMPLE must be replaced before launch. Keep demo_mode true until real client details are in; it adds noindex to every page and the yellow demo banner. accent: brand colour #rrggbb used for buttons and highlights (the build stops if it is too dark to read). heat: the warm second colour used for heating visuals (#rrggbb). logo: path to the client's logo, e.g. assets/img/client/logo.png (transparent PNG best); empty = built-in mark + name. services: remove any slug the client does not offer, then fix any sentences listed in _build/removed-service-mentions.txt. photos: the client's own job photos only (see _build/photos.py). intro: false turns the opening animation off; intro_scope 'all' plays it on whichever page a visitor lands on first, 'home' limits it to the home page. hero_fx: false turns off the animated airflow behind the home hero. emergency_24_7: true ONLY if the client really answers no-heat calls around the clock; it changes the wording of the no-heat band. estimator: see the _README inside it.
hours_note: Installations and home visits by appointment

estimator._README: Instant system estimate (/system-estimate/). Set the client's real installed prices before launch. Everything runs in the visitor's browser; nothing is sent until they submit the form. systems: each system type the client installs, with base = the typical installed price in USD for a mid-size home (1,200-2,000 sq ft) at the standard efficiency tier, including removal of old equipment and normal venting/connection work. For mini-splits, extra_zone = added price per additional indoor head. Remove a system the client doesn't install. home_sizes / tiers: price_mult per option. addons: optional extras with a flat price. range_pct = how far the low/high ends sit from the middle (12 = -12%/+12%). minimum_job = smallest replacement job the client takes. round_to = rounding for displayed numbers. repair_rule: the 'age x repair cost' rule-of-thumb threshold used by the repair-or-replace check; set enabled false to hide that check.
